blurb: ICE and Hyperliquid talks, OTL standard, and OKX’s $53M Coinone bet show crypto infra is heating up fast.
title: Crypto Trading Signals - May 29, 2026
top_story_headline: NYSE parent ICE held multiple talks with Hyperliquid as CEO Jeffrey Sprecher pushes regulators for equal access to booming onchain perpetual futures market
top_story_comment: June 11 SpaceX pricing is the clean stress test: if TradeXYZ’s pre-IPO perp lands anywhere near the bookbuild, banks and exchange operators lose exclusive control over first price discovery. ICE can pipe Brent/WTI benchmarks into OKX’s 120M-user distribution, but Hyperliquid’s edge is different: 24/7 USDC margin, public flow, and traders willing to absorb weekend oil/geopolitical risk when legacy venues are shut. The likely compromise is surveillance, KYC, and oracle licensing wrapped around perp markets that already have offshore liquidity.
